action: Preserve v1r23 unchanged. diagnosis: Generic framework context-budgeting defect at the manuscript generation boundary. The failure concerns serialization/input size, not the scientific outcome.

The same oversized manuscript-drafting request was retried three times and failed deterministically with context_length_exceeded.
